label: the labial row pa pha ba bha ma
note: PA, BA, BHA and MA were taught and PHA had no atom. MR-W64-pha closes it at chapter 64 and completes the FIFTH and last plain-and-aspirated pair, so every stop in the script now has its partner. It also records the drift the row does not predict: in borrowed words such as फोन many speakers give फ the sound of an English f rather than the puffed p, so one shape covers two sounds.
